{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-9098.40","title":"radio.py: DelayedRxReadyEvent is a no-op for polling RX","description":"## Problem

9098.18 queued DelayedRxReadyEvent at expire_us so BARRIER_SYNC lands on the 1 us TTL. 9098.23 pops it before RxTimeoutEvent and has _handle_rx_timeout call deliver_pending_packets before dropping stash.

Both paths only deliver callback RX (node.rx_callbacks is not None). RadioMixin._handle_event for DelayedRxReadyEvent is:

    self.deliver_pending_packets()
    return

deliver_pending_packets skips nodes with rx_callbacks is None. Polling get_rx_result (metrics.py module docstring: the production ~1 ms poll while a node waits; start_receive / tests / examples) is not invoked.

Same-tick timeout for a polling node:

1. DelayedRxReadyEvent runs, delivers nothing, stash still at expire_us.
2. RxTimeoutEvent: _handle_rx_timeout sees rx_callbacks is None, skips deliver, then _drop_delayed_rx_for_receiver and super() sets IDLE.
3. Later get_rx_result is None. The only eligible microsecond is gone (now > expire_us prunes).

test_same_tick_timeout_does_not_drop_delayed_callback / test_callback_delivery_with_latency_rule use enter_rx_mode. TestDelayedRxStash polling tests advance_to(expire) then get_rx_result with no RxTimeout at that tick (start_receive is either unused or times out at 1 ms, well before expire).

This is not 9098.18 (callback/HIL never waking at expire) and not 9098.23 (timeout sorted before DelayedRx). Event order is fixed; the wake still does not serve the polling API, and timeout teardown still consumes the TTL.

## Files

- python/src/lichen/sim/simulation/radio.py (_handle_event DelayedRxReadyEvent, _handle_rx_timeout, _reinject_delayed_candidates equality TTL)
- python/src/lichen/sim/events.py (DelayedRxReadyEvent docstring claims the handler delivers for the node)
- python/tests/sim/test_radio.py (callback-only same-tick tests)
